Technical constraints / acceptance criteria:
- No outbound network connectivity from inference cluster once deployed (air-gapped).
- Hardware: validated on selected NVIDIA A100-class on controlled racks; potential future GEN-4 GPUs.
- KMS/HSM: require integration with on-prem HSM (PKCS#11) + FIPS 140-2/3 compliance.
